site.tagline: Independent games and apps from Maharashtra, India.
site.description: Sunlight creates thoughtful games and useful apps with clear support and transparent policies.

products.name: Auction XI
products.summary: Build your club, compete in player auctions and guide your XI through a fictional cricket league world.
products.headline: Build the club. Pick the XI. Chase the title.
products.description: Auction XI is a single-player cricket management game with squad building, staff, facilities, player development and simulated matchdays.

highlights.title: Build your squad
highlights.description: Recruit players at auction, develop talent and balance club finances.

highlights.title: Run matchday
highlights.description: Choose your XI and tactics, follow matches and compete across leagues and cups.

products.name: Cricket: Player and Manager
products.summary: Build a complete cricket life as a player or lead a club as a manager in a deep, fictional career simulation.
products.headline: Two careers. One cricket world.
products.description: Cricket: Player and Manager is a fictional single-player simulation built around meaningful cricket decisions, long-term progression and seasons that remember what happened.

highlights.title: Player Career
highlights.description: Start in Grade A cricket, earn selection through performance and shape a career across youth, domestic and international levels.

highlights.title: Manager Career
highlights.description: Run squads, tactics, transfers, facilities and matchdays while building a club over multiple seasons.
